Bitcoin ETF Inflows Hit $1B Daily Record as Institutional Demand Surges

BTC
Bitcoin 3 min read
Key Takeaway
Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $1 billion in daily net inflows for the first time, signaling unprecedented institutional demand and potential for further price appreciation.

Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) in the United States have reached a major milestone, recording over $1 billion in net inflows in a single trading day for the first time since their launch.

BlackRock's IBIT led the charge with approximately $580 million in inflows, followed by Fidelity's FBTC with $210 million. Analysts point to growing institutional adoption and renewed retail interest as key drivers.

"This is a watershed moment for Bitcoin adoption," said one market analyst. "The sustained institutional interest suggests we're in a fundamentally different market cycle than previous years."

Bitcoin responded positively, climbing to a two-week high of $44,250 before consolidating around the $43,900 level. Technical analysts note the formation of a bullish flag pattern, with targets pointing toward $48,000.
